_about: The Blowfish agent's client tools, one source of truth (the table in docs/ROHAN.md says the same). npm run agent:tools compares the agent with this file; npm run agent:tools -- --apply adds the ones the agent is missing. Every tool is type client and waits for a response. Names must match CLIENT_TOOL_NAMES in shared/teardown.ts.

tools.name: get_scene
tools.description: What the user can see now: the objects in view, which one is in the centre, the exploded parts with their ids, and the saved models.

tools.name: set_overlay
tools.description: Turn Blowfish's labels on (true) or go back to the clean camera view (false). Off also puts everything back.

on.description: true for labels on, false for the clean camera view

tools.name: select_object
tools.description: Select an object in view. Leave empty for the one in the centre.

object_id.description: id from get_scene; leave empty for the object in the centre

tools.name: explode
tools.description: Bring a 3D model of the object the user is looking at into the middle of the view and spread its parts. amount 0.12 = assembled ("analyse this", "put it back together", "collapse it"), 1 = fully exploded, 0 closes it.

object_id.description: leave empty for "this"; "arm-hand" for the hand or arm, "eye" for the eye, or a saved model's id or name

tools.name: highlight_part
tools.description: Light up one part before talking about it. Returns its facts and safety note.

part_id.description: a part id from the explode reply or get_scene

tools.name: show_step
tools.description: Show step n of the walkthrough (repair steps, how a key press works, or the path of light in the eye).

tools.name: reset_view
tools.description: Put the model away (it is saved for later): collapse everything and clear the selection.

tools.name: rotate_model
tools.description: Turn the floating model. "around" turns it half a turn.

direction.description: left, right, up, down or around

degrees.description: only if the user says a number; default 45, around 180

tools.name: get_pose
tools.description: Which finger is pressing right now and which muscle part ids are working.

tools.name: adjust_view
tools.description: Move the view of the floating model without changing it: zoom in or out, move it left, right, up or down, put it back in the middle (also normal size and facing the front), or back to normal size.

action.description: zoom_in, zoom_out, move_left, move_right, move_up, move_down, centre or normal_size

amount.description: only if the user says how much: zoom factor (default 1.5) or distance in model widths (default 0.5)
